sourceCopy.name: DOCX Editor
sourceCopy.title: Edit DOCX Online Free | UsefulVerse
sourceCopy.description: Edit text in a modern DOCX document on your device, keep other package parts, preview changes, and download a new Word file.
sourceCopy.intro: Make focused text edits to a modern Word DOCX file in this browser. The editor changes existing text runs in the main document and keeps other document parts unchanged. It is not a full Word replacement, and complex formatting may not preview here.
sourceCopy.howQuestion: What can I edit in a DOCX file?
sourceCopy.howAnswer: You can edit existing text segments in paragraphs and table cells in a modern .docx file, preview the text and download an edited copy. This editor does not add or remove paragraphs, change formatting, edit headers or footers, or support tracked changes.
sourceCopy.privacyAnswer: No. The file is processed in this browser after you choose it. It is not uploaded, saved automatically or sent to a server.

fields.fileHint: Modern .docx only. Maximum 25 MiB, 80 MiB expanded package, 8 MiB document XML, 500 text segments and 250,000 characters. Large documents work better on a computer.
fields.scopeNote: This focused editor changes only existing text runs in the main document. It preserves styles, images and other package-part contents, but repacks the DOCX ZIP container. It does not edit headers, footers, comments, footnotes, formatting, paragraph structure or tracked changes. Macros and digitally signed packages are not supported.
fields.privacyNote: Processing happens on your device after you choose a file. No upload, account, API, autosave or server processing.

messages.ready: Document opened. Edit the existing text segments below, then download a new copy.
messages.invalid: This file is not a supported modern DOCX document.
messages.tooLarge: The file or its expanded contents exceed this device-side limit.
messages.noText: No editable text segments were found in the main document.
messages.unsupported: This document uses tracked changes, which this focused editor does not support.
messages.failed: The DOCX could not be opened safely in this browser.
messages.changed: Text preview updated. Download the new DOCX when ready.
messages.downloaded: The edited DOCX download is ready.
messages.copyUnavailable: Clipboard access is unavailable. Select the preview text to copy it.

additionalFaqs.question: Will the edited file keep my existing formatting?
additionalFaqs.answer: Text styles and other package-part contents are preserved. When a text segment is replaced, its existing run formatting is retained; this tool does not offer rich text formatting controls or guarantee that every Word feature renders identically.

additionalFaqs.question: Can this edit tracked changes, headers, or signed documents?
additionalFaqs.answer: No. The focused editor changes text runs in the main document only. Tracked-change workflows, headers and footers, macros and digitally signed files are not supported.
